program:
alphabet a b

is_bos = bos
is_a = symbol a
is_b = symbol b
h1_1 = rightmost(true, !is_a@i & is_b@i & !is_a@j)
h2_1 = rightmost(!h1_1@i & !is_bos@j, !h1_1@i & !is_bos@j)
h3_1 = rightmost(!h1_1@i & h2_1@i, !h1_1@i)
h4_1 = rightmost(!is_a@i & is_b@i & h1_1@i & !h2_1@i & !h3_1@i & !is_a@j, !is_a@i & is_b@i & !h2_1@i & !h3_1@i)
h5_1 = rightmost(true, !h2_1@i & !h3_1@i & !is_a@j)
accept = !h1_1 & !h4_1 & !h5_1

output accept
